messages:
Sophie (docs): FYI I opened a small PR to clarify region availability and add a short Brazil/HK footnote plus updated SDK snippets that show the region header + env var pattern. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2187

Liam (i18n): Nice. Quick note on wording: avoid absolute phrasing like 'data stays in' for docs pages. Suggest 'data residency options may be available' language so it's not a promise. Also can we include a 1-line pt-BR / zh-HK piece? Not full translation, just the footnote.

Ravi (SDK): Looked at the snippet. Currently uses `X-Region` which isn't the canonical header. We should show `X-Redwood-Region` and also demonstrate setting region via env var on the SDK client. Proposed code: 
```js
// prefer setting client-level region via env
const REGION = process.env.REDWOOD_REGION || 'us-east-1'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ region: REGION, apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', prompt: 'Hello' })
// per-request header pattern (hosted/private)
fetch('/v1/generate', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.TOKEN}`, 'X-Redwood-Region': 'eu-west-1' }, body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'Q' }) })
```

Nina (legal): Please avoid implying guarantees about residency. Suggest: "Data residency options are available in select regions; customers should consult their contract or account team for specifics and audit options." Also add links to Private deployments and SLA page.

Sophie (docs): Thanks both. I'll swap to `X-Redwood-Region`, add the env var client example, and use Nina's phrasing. Liam 94 can you draft the short pt-BR and zh-HK footnotes? Keep them one line each.

Liam (i18n): Draft pt-BR: "Ope7f5es de resideancia de dados este3o disponedveis em regif5es selecionadas; consulte seu contrato ou equipe de conta para detalhes." Draft zh-HK (traditional): "部分地區提供數據駐留選項；有關保證與稽核日誌，請聯絡您的合約或客戶經理。" Will ask localization lead for a quick sanity check.

Ravi (SDK): One extra note for accuracy: Dedicated customers route by capacity pool and the per-request header is ignored for those deployments. Recommend adding a parenthetical: "(Note: Dedicated capacity customers should use their account-configured pool; per-request region header is applicable to Hosted and Private control-plane routing.)"

Sophie (docs): Adding that parenthetical and the links. I'll also make the SDK snippet show a non-hardcoded model and mention the header is optional for SDK clients. Will push an update in ~20m.

Nina (legal): LGTM once the SLA link is included.

DocsBot: Preview build ready for PR 2187: https://deploy-preview-redwood-docs.netlify.app/pr-2187/regions.html

Liam (i18n): Localization lead approved the short bits with minor punctuation tweak.

Sophie (docs): Update pushed. Planning to merge in 10 unless anyone objects. :shipit:
